name: Heterogeneous Medium Sampling
definition: For GridDensityMedium, extra effort is needed due to its heterogeneous nature. Regular tracking applies standard homogeneous medium techniques to voxels individually, but this is costly with many voxels and cannot be used with linear interpolation.
summary: Heterogeneous Medium Sampling determines interaction distances in spatially varying media by integrating the extinction coefficient, handling continuous variation more efficiently than voxel-by-voxel tracking.
